# Sirach Chapter 24 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 24 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

*[WISDOM'S SELF-PRAISE — the theological climax of Sirach. Wisdom speaks in the heavenly council and then is identified with the Torah of Moses. This chapter stands behind John 1:1-18, Colossians 1:15-20, and Proverbs 8. All agents are directed to render it with gravity.]*

**24:1** Wisdom will praise her own soul and in the midst of her people she will glory.

**24:2** In the assembly of the Most High she will open her mouth, and before his host she will boast:

**24:3** "I came forth from the mouth of the Most High, and like a mist I covered the earth.

**24:4** I dwelt in the heights, and my throne was in a pillar of cloud.

**24:5** The vault of heaven I encircled alone, and in the depth of the abysses I walked about.

**24:6** In the waves of the sea and in all the earth, and in every people and nation I held dominion.

**24:7** Among all of these I sought rest, and in whose inheritance I would lodge.

**24:8** Then the Creator of all gave me a commandment, and he who created me gave rest to my tent; and he said, 'Let your dwelling place be in Jacob, and in Israel let your inheritance be.'

**24:9** Before the age, from the beginning, he created me; and until the age I shall not cease to be.

**24:10** In the holy tent I ministered before him, and so I was established in Zion.

**24:11** In the city he loved likewise he gave me rest, and in Jerusalem was my authority.

**24:12** And I took root in a people whom he had honored, and in the portion of the LORD, his inheritance.

**24:13** Like a cedar in Lebanon I was exalted, and like a cypress on the mountains of Hermon.

**24:14** Like a palm tree I was exalted in En-gedi, and like rose-bushes in Jericho; like a beautiful olive tree in the plain, and like a plane tree I was exalted.

**24:15** Like cinnamon and fragrant aspalathos I gave forth fragrance; like choice myrrh I gave out sweet aroma; like galbanum and onycha and stacte, and like the scent of frankincense in the tent.

**24:16** Like a terebinth I spread out my branches, and my branches are branches of glory and of grace.

**24:17** Like a vine I put forth shoots of grace, and my flowers are fruit of glory and of wealth.

**24:19** Come to me, all you who desire me, and eat your fill of my produce.

**24:20** For the remembrance of me is sweeter than honey, and my inheritance sweeter than the honeycomb.

**24:21** Those who eat me will hunger still for more, and those who drink me will thirst still for more.

**24:22** Whoever obeys me will not be put to shame, and those who work in me will not sin."

**24:23** All these things are the book of the covenant of the Most High God, the law which Moses commanded us as an inheritance for the assemblies of Jacob.

**24:24** [He fills wisdom with understanding like the Pishon, and like the Tigris in the days of the new fruits.]

**24:25** He fills it with understanding like the Euphrates, and like the Jordan in the days of harvest.

**24:26** He makes instruction shine forth like light, like the Gehon in the days of the vintage.

**24:27** The first man has not finished knowing her, nor likewise has the last traced out her ways.

**24:28** For from the sea her thought was filled, and her counsel from the great deep.

**24:29** I myself am like a canal from a river, and like a water channel I went out into a garden.

**24:30** I said, "I will water my garden and I will drench my garden bed"; and behold, my canal became a river, and my river became a sea.

**24:31** I will make instruction shine again like the morning light, and cause it to gleam forth afar.

**24:32** I will again pour out teaching like prophecy, and leave it for all the generations of the age.

**24:33** See that I have not labored for myself alone, but for all who seek wisdom.

**24:34** [See that I have not labored for myself alone, but for all those who seek her.]
